display.purpose: Page titles, login headword. The largest typographic element on any screen.

headline.purpose: Section headings, metric values. Carries weight without competing with Display.

body.purpose: Running text, table cells, form values. Cap line length at 65ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, eyebrows, metadata, badge text. The workhorse of information density.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus indicator on interactive elements. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Button hover, nav highlight, link color shifts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action button. Marigold background, the only saturated surface on any given screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.78rem + 0.15vw, 0.875rem); font-weight: 600; background: oklch(52% 0.16 45); color: oklch(99% 0.005 45); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(46% 0.17 45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(52% 0.16 45 / 10%); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button for secondary actions. Transparent with a rule border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.78rem + 0.15vw, 0.875rem); font-weight: 600; background: transparent; color: oklch(45% 0.03 45); border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.012 45); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(94.5% 0.012 45); border-color: oklch(78% 0.018 45); color: oklch(22% 0.02 45); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(52% 0.16 45 / 10%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Warm-white background, rule border, marigold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.78rem + 0.15vw, 0.875rem); background: oklch(99% 0.005 45); color: oklch(22% 0.02 45); border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.012 45); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(52% 0.16 45); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(52% 0.16 45 / 10%); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(58% 0.025 45); }

components.name: Badge (Positive)
components.description: Status badge for approved, active, and succeeded states.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.6875rem, 0.65rem + 0.15vw, 0.75rem); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-badge-positive { background: oklch(95% 0.025 155); color: oklch(45% 0.12 155); } .ds-badge-positive .ds-badge-dot { background: oklch(45% 0.12 155); }

components.name: Badge (Caution)
components.description: Status badge for pending and running states.
components.css: .ds-badge-caution { background: oklch(95% 0.03 85); color: oklch(52% 0.12 85); } .ds-badge-caution .ds-badge-dot { background: oklch(52% 0.12 85); }

components.name: Badge (Negative)
components.description: Status badge for failed and rejected states.
components.css: .ds-badge-negative { background: oklch(95% 0.025 25); color: oklch(48% 0.14 25); } .ds-badge-negative .ds-badge-dot { background: oklch(48% 0.14 25); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped filter control for queue and list views.
components.html: EnglishKorean
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.012 45); border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; color: oklch(45% 0.03 45); background: oklch(99% 0.005 45); font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.6875rem, 0.65rem + 0.15vw, 0.75rem); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: oklch(78% 0.018 45); } .ds-chip-active { color: oklch(52% 0.16 45); border-color: oklch(83% 0.04 45); background: oklch(93% 0.035 45); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Dark sidebar with warm-ink navigation items. Active state marked with a marigold left border.
components.html: DashboardAI ReviewReleases
components.css: .ds-sidebar-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; background: oklch(22% 0.018 45); padding: 8px 0; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 12px 24px; color: oklch(72% 0.015 45); text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.78rem + 0.15vw, 0.875rem); font-weight: 400; border-left: 3px solid transparent; transition: color 120ms ease-out, background 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: oklch(90% 0.01 45); background: oklch(28% 0.015 45); } .ds-nav-active { color: oklch(90% 0.01 45); background: oklch(28% 0.02 45); border-left-color: oklch(52% 0.16 45); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Like a typesetter's proof: precise, structured, type-forward. Every element is set with the same care a compositor gives to a page of reference text. The medium is the message; the typography is the interface.

Yori Admin is the working console for a multilingual Japanese dictionary. It serves a single curator doing operational work: reviewing AI translations, shipping releases, inspecting entries. The aesthetic is editorial meets tech: the typographic sophistication and information hierarchy of quality publishing, applied with the interaction speed of a modern tool. It is not retro or nostalgic. It is contemporary editorial precision.

The system uses a warm neutral palette anchored to OKLCH hue 45 (paper-cream, ink, stone). One accent color, marigold, marks the single most important action on each screen. Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth appears only through tonal layering and subtle border shifts on interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Serif + sans pairing as primary brand signal
Warm OKLCH neutrals tinted to hue 45; no pure black, no pure white
Single marigold accent used with restraint
Flat surfaces, no shadows; depth from tonal shifts and hairline rules
Information density that adapts to the task at hand
CJK-ready typography with dedicated font stacks

rules.name: The Single Pot Rule
rules.body: Marigold is the only chromatic accent outside semantic status colors. If a screen has more than one marigold-highlighted element competing for attention, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward hue 45. Pure #000 and pure #fff are forbidden.

rules.name: The Proof Reader's Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for headings and display elements only. Body text, labels, and interactive elements use Source Sans 3.

rules.name: The CJK Parity Rule
rules.body: Japanese, Korean, and Chinese text must use the dedicated Noto Sans stacks and remain legible at body sizes. Never fall back to the serif stack for CJK body text.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow for ambient depth, card elevation, or surface layering. The only permitted shadow is the focus ring on interactive elements.

dos: Do use Fraunces for headings and display elements only; keep body text and UI chrome in Source Sans 3.
Do use OKLCH for all color definitions, with hue 45 as the shared warmth anchor.
Do vary information density by context: dense for review queues, spacious for login and single-entry views.
Do use hairline rules and tonal shifts to create visual separation between sections.
Do test all screens with mixed Japanese-English content at body sizes.
Do use the focus ring (3px marigold at 10% opacity) on every interactive element.
donts: Don't use AI/dark-mode tech aesthetic: no cyan-on-dark, neon accents, purple gradients, glassmorphism, or glow effects.
Don't add decorative Japanese theming: no kanji watermarks on operational screens, no ornamental borders, no shrine-gate motifs, no cherry blossom backgrounds.
Don't write wordy, hand-holding copy: no long help text under every field, no intro paragraphs that restate the heading.
Don't style anything to read as 'AI startup' or generic 'developer tool.'
Don't use box-shadow for surface elevation. The only shadow is the focus ring.
Don't use pure #000 or #fff. Every neutral carries hue-45 warmth.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't highlight more than one element per screen with marigold.
Don't use card grids where every card is the same size with icon + heading + text repeated.
